runs.text: This does not calculate a true “percentile.”

runs: Official WHO growth percentiles are computed from large statistical parameter tables (LMS), which can’t be reliably reproduced here. Instead, we use the midpoint of the commonly-cited “3rd–97th percentile range” as a reference average, and just show how far above or below that average your numbers are. Supported range: 0–24 months.
For an accurate growth percentile and developmental assessment, check with a pediatrician at a well-baby visit. Don’t judge your baby’s growth from this result alone.
